{{Quote|&hellip;''Fate's Hand'', your permit is in order. Proceed to capital landing platform A-627.|A Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], to "[[Rex/Legends|Rex]]"|<ref name="TCW 3" />}}
'''Capital landing platform A-627''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] operatives went on an undercover [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|mission]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned planet, where they were instructed to land at capital landing platform A-627.<ref name="TCW 3" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Capital landing platform A-627 first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] comic book [[The Clone Wars 3|''The Clone Wars'' 3]], written by [[Henry Gilroy]].<ref name="TCW 3" />
